verdict.rationale: Ramp shows some multi-item handling. The multi-entity integration syncs transaction and reimbursement data to multiple entities "in a single step," and the MCP can find all transactions missing receipts in a window and draft reminders. The CLI is described as "built for scripted loops" with JSON agent output, so agents can iterate approvals and edits across many items, but only through per-item scripting rather than native bulk endpoints. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints or bulk approve/edit commands, explicit bulk actions in MCP tools, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk operations at scale.
